details:
Q1: Which part of the repository should this issue improve?
Choices:
A. The issue → PR pipeline phases (clarify / plan / implement workflows and their prompts) (RECOMMENDED)
B. Review & Autofix (`review_autofix.yml` and its helper scripts)
C. The orchestrator (`orchestrate_poll.yml`, `scripts/orchestrate_poll_process.sh`, tracking-issue state)
D. Consumer onboarding and updates (`workflow-templates/`, the Update Workflows wrapper, README quickstart)
E. Something else. Name the file, workflow or feature in your `/answer`.
Q2: What kind of "better" do you mean?
Choices:
A. Fix a specific bug or failure. Include a run URL, run ID or the error text in your `/answer` (RECOMMENDED)
B. Lower cost or resource use: fewer runner jobs, fewer GitHub API calls, fewer model tokens
C. Faster delivery: lower end-to-end latency
D. Clearer or more accurate documentation (README, `agents.md` fragments, `docs/`)
E. A new capability. Describe the desired behavior in your `/answer`.
Q3: How will we know this issue is done?
Choices:
A. A concrete, checkable result that you state in your `/answer` (for example "run X no longer fails with error Y", or "workflow Z uses N fewer jobs per PR") (RECOMMENDED)
B. Close it with no code change: the request is too vague to act on, and a new, specific issue will be filed instead
**Note:** Q3:B overrides Q1 and Q2. If you choose it, you don't need to answer them.
